fallback_rules: if strict helper launch produces no wrapper-start sentinel by the cadence gate, classify helper execution gap
if wrapper-start exists but wrapper-exit is missing, classify wrapper still running or hung
if wrapper-exit exists but expected notifier file is missing, use bridge copy repair only after cadence gate
if raw bridge output exists and strict quality passes after copy, allow five-lane normalization
do not advance phase while either CLI lane lacks final-message quality pass
publish only status receipts, hashes, counts, and redacted telemetry
